description_en: This API is used to obtain the statistics on the regional distribution of channels
description_zh: 本接口用于获取频道地区分布统计数据
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-channel-area-distribution-stat-data --app-id testappid --channel-id testid --created-ts 1614936817 --destroyed-ts 1614936817 --parent-area '中国_浙江省' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeChannelAreaDistributionStatData

parameters.help_en: Timestamp of channel creation. Supports querying data from the last 30 days. Represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
parameters.help_zh: 创建频道的时间戳，支持查询最近30天的数据。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: created_ts

parameters.help_en:
Channel release time, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. If the parameter is empty, the current time is used.  
If the provided channel release time exceeds the actual release time, data from the creation time to the actual release time will be returned.
parameters.help_zh:
频道释放时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空表示获取当前时间。
如果传入的频道释放时间超过真实的释放时间，将返回从创建时间开始到真实释放时间之间的数据
parameters.name: destroyed_ts

parameters.help_en: Parent region name. For example, the parent of Shenzhen City is Guangdong Province. If the parameter is empty, statistics are returned at the global level (country dimension), such as China or the United Kingdom.
parameters.help_zh: 父级地区名称，例如：深圳市的父级为广东省。参数为空表示世界范围（国家维度）的统计，例如：中国、英国
parameters.name: parent_area
